interface.title: WebXR Custom Pattern Creator (Custom/index.html)
interface.field: Display metrology / vision science: optical quality testing of VR/AR (WebXR) headsets
interface.stage_of_work: Building the stimulus or test scene before measurement, and sharing it so the identical scene can be shown on several headsets
interface.what_it_is_for: Put together, edit, put in order and save as JSON the packages of standard test patterns (grilles, dot arrays, checkerboards, bullseyes, textured planes and so on) that are shown in a WebXR scene, so different headsets can be compared on the same scene.

data.note: The built-in 'default' package of 15 patterns loads automatically (red, green, blue, white, grille, crosshair, line, circular dot array, dot array, checkerboard_w/_b, ring_w1/w2/w5, Flying Spot), and all work was done on it. It also includes the AAPM TG18/TG270 test-image textures (TG18-QC, TG18-BR and others). Both test files (uploaded_textures_demo.JSON and demo_scene.JSON) were rejected by 'Upload Package' with the alert 'Invalid package'. Two default.JSON files were saved (63 KB). Unsaved edits were lost when the page reloaded.

features.name: Parametric stimulus-element editor with live 3D preview
features.general: Pick one element of a scene from a list, change its shared settings (position, rotation, colour) and its type-specific settings in a form, and see the rendered scene update straight away; switch to an advanced coordinate mode when needed
features.specific: Edit Entity panel: Entity dropdown → Universal Settings (α/y/r position, rotation, Entity Color picker; 'A' Advanced gives x/y/z and 3-axis rotation) → Specific Settings (e.g. Number of dots/rings, Radius, Spacing, Fill center dot; Height/Width/Texture; Number of bars/Secondary Color) → A-Frame preview redraws
steps: Switch Display→Edit and Add Entity→Edit Entity
Choose the entity in the Entity dropdown
Type values in Universal/Specific Settings and press Enter
Pick a colour in the colour-square picker
Optionally press 'A' for Cartesian x/y/z and 3-axis rotation
Watch the preview update
serves_tasks: Change the settings of an existing pattern element and see the result straight away
Change a pattern's geometry and orientation
Optionally switch from angular to Cartesian placement for exact 3D position and rotation

features.name: Add / duplicate / delete elements from a typed palette
features.general: Add items to a scene by choosing a type from a palette, copy an existing item, or delete it after a confirmation; the list of items updates each time
features.specific: Add Entity: Type of entity (circle, plane, triangle, gradient, checkerboard, grille, dot array, circular dot array, bullseye, text, timer) → Add to Pattern; Duplicate Entity icon creates plane1 from plane0; trash icon asks 'Delete the selected entity?' (delete seen once in the run, not confirmed by the replay)
steps: Pick a Type of entity
Press Add to Pattern (the new entity appears in the preview and in the Entity dropdown)
Select an entity and press Duplicate Entity
Select an entity and press the trash icon, then confirm (not confirmed by the replay)
serves_tasks: Add new standard elements to the scene
Copy an element and place the copy somewhere else with a different image

features.name: Reference test-image texture on a plane
features.general: Lay a standard calibration image on a surface, with the size set from the image, and clear the tint so the true grey levels show
features.specific: Plane Specific Settings: Texture dropdown with the built-in AAPM TG18-QC/CH/MM1/MM2/PQC/BR and TG270sQC images (plane resizes to 125×125); Entity Color multiplies the texture, so it must be #ffffff. An 'Upload Textures' file input for your own images is present but was not tried
steps: Add or select a plane entity
Choose a texture in the Texture dropdown
Set Entity Color to white so the texture is not tinted
Adjust position, height and width
serves_tasks: Put a standard reference test image on a surface and remove the colour tint so its true grey levels show

features.name: Keyframe movement sequence for a stimulus
features.general: Give an element a list of movement steps (pause, jump, linear path, back-and-forth), each with start and end points, speed and acceleration, and play, pause or stop it in the preview
features.specific: Wand 'Open animation list' → Animation List '+' adds steps → select a step → Movement Type (Pause / Discontinuous / Start to finish / Rubberband), Start/End Point (α, y, r), Speed, Acceleration → Play / Pause / Stop in Movement Settings (only Start to finish, Play and Stop were tried)
steps: Open the Animation List with the wand button
Press + to add a step and click it
Choose a Movement Type
Enter start/end points, speed and acceleration
Press Play to watch it, Stop to go back to the start
serves_tasks: Make an element move from one point to another at a set speed, and play it

features.name: Ordered playlist of scenes with multi-select, copy/paste, drag reorder and keyboard stepping
features.general: Keep an ordered list of scenes: select several with Ctrl-click, copy and paste them, drag to reorder, delete the selection, and step through the list in order with the arrow keys
features.specific: Pattern List: Ctrl+click to multi-select; Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V append copies such as 'red (1)'; drag an item to a new position; the Delete Patterns trash removes the selection; ArrowDown moves to the next pattern in the preview
steps: Click a pattern, Ctrl+click more
Press Ctrl+C then Ctrl+V to append copies
Drag an item to a new place in the list
Select items and press Delete Patterns
Press ArrowDown to step through the sequence
serves_tasks: Select several patterns and copy them into the sequence
Change the order of the sequence by dragging
Step through the patterns in order with the keyboard

Collect the downloaded <package>.JSON
